description: Abstract class defining the interface and some static properties for cryptographic clients in AWS SDK, including support for cipher methods, encryption, and decryption workflows.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClient
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface for cryptographic operations such as encryption and decryption within AWS SDK, including supported cipher types and key wrapping.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name based on cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name from an AES name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create an encryption stream with given cipher details and materials.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create a decryption stream with given cipher details and materials.
